description: Independent captured reporting supports a Dec. 26 Umuekwenu gathering with hundreds and a Dec. 19 University of Abuja rally whose attendance is unknown. Military retirees protested at the Finance Ministry Dec. 5, but no simultaneous crowd count is captured. Several WANEP-only leads remain unverified because the inherited WANEP open response was mismapped and cannot be used or retried. The 4-query discovery batch Q008–Q011 was stored as one aggregated response with no query-to-result attribution.

The prior WANEP body request is part of the coordinator-recorded multi-open payload mismatch. The exact destination response is not attributable; no claims from its rendered body are used. The new four-query Q008–Q011 batch output is preserved, but the tool response did not provide per-query alignment.
